senses.gloss: Nimrin in Syria, the last station of messengers proclaiming the new moon.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:7:3">Y. Keth. II, 26ᵈ</cite> top <he>עד מקום ששלוחי … עד נ׳</he> as far as the messengers to announce the new moon go, as far as N.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:4:3">Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אילין דאזלין לנְמוֹרִין</he> those messengers who go to N.—Tosef. Yoma V (IV), 3 <he>ככותבת הנימרין</he>, v. <cite ref="N00896"><he>נִמְרִית</he></cite>.
